apps.name: F-Droid
apps.localizedDescription: F-Droid is an installable catalogue of FOSS (Free and Open Source Software) applications for the Android platform.

apps.name: Aurora Store
apps.localizedDescription: Aurora Store is an unofficial, FOSS client to Google's Play Store with an elegant design. Not only does it download, update, and search for apps, it empowers the user with new features.

apps.name: Termux
apps.localizedDescription: Termux is an Android terminal emulator and Linux environment app that works directly with no rooting or setup required.

apps.name: VLC
apps.localizedDescription: VLC for Android is a full audio player, with a complete database, an equalizer and filters, playing all weird audio formats.

apps.name: Shattered Pixel Dungeon
apps.localizedDescription: A libGDX roguelike: five heroes, four regions, one very unfair dungeon. Route: Translation Layer.

apps.name: Mindustry
apps.localizedDescription: A libGDX tower-defense factory hybrid: build conveyor-fed defenses and survive the waves. Route: Translation Layer.

apps.name: Vector Pinball
apps.localizedDescription: Pinball on a custom minimal engine — a good first test of the Translation Layer. Route: Translation Layer.

apps.name: Mouse Pounce
apps.localizedDescription: Card game of quick paws by the Vector Pinball developer — pure Java, well inside the Translation Layer's coverage.

apps.name: PySolFC
apps.localizedDescription: Over a thousand solitaire variants in one collection — a large pure-Python/Java app exercising the Translation Layer deeply.

apps.name: NewPipe
apps.localizedDescription: A lightweight streaming front-end for video services, with subscriptions and background playback — no account or proprietary client libraries needed.

apps.name: AntennaPod
apps.localizedDescription: A podcast manager and player: subscriptions, downloads, and queueing in a polished open-source package.

apps.name: Feeder
apps.localizedDescription: A clean RSS/Atom feed reader — subscribe to sites and read everything in one timeline, no account required.
